categories.main_business_segments: Yantai Ishikawa Sealing Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of engine sealing products and sealing materials. Its main product lines include sealing gaskets, heat insulation shields, sealing fiberboards, and metal coated sheets. These products are mainly applied in automotive, motorcycle, shipbuilding, general machinery, refrigeration, and petrochemical industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including stamping, cutting, and coating processes for sealing products. It has developed proprietary technologies in metal coated sheets with both dry and wet coating methods, and uses CAE simulation for product design optimization. The company also utilizes automated production lines with computer-controlled processes to ensure product consistency and quality, and engages in synchronous R&D with customers and academic institutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic diesel engine manufacturers and automotive OEMs such as Weichai Holding, China FAW, China National Heavy Duty Truck Group, SAIC Motor, and Changan Automobile. The company also serves international clients including Cummins and has expanded into new energy vehicle manufacturers. Its products cater primarily to the commercial vehicle market, especially heavy-duty trucks, and are increasingly used in new energy vehicles and other industrial sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with domestic sales accounting for over 98% of revenue. It is actively expanding its international market presence through participation in automotive parts exhibitions in Germany and the USA and has begun supplying foreign brands with fiberboard products. Export sales remain a small but growing portion of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yantai Ishikawa Sealing Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain, manufacturing critical sealing components and materials for engine and vehicle assembly. It supplies directly to engine manufacturers and vehicle OEMs, positioning itself as a core supplier in the engine sealing niche.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in sealing technologies aligned with evolving emission standards such as China VI and Euro VI. R&D priorities include developing low surface pressure auxiliary gaskets, multi-fuel compatible cylinder head gaskets, high-temperature heat shields, diamond friction pads, and thick coated metal sheets. It pursues a combination of preemptive, synchronous, and industry-academia collaborative R&D to maintain technological leadership and expand into new materials and new energy vehicle applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of sealing products and materials to engine manufacturers, automotive OEMs, and industrial clients. The company uses a direct sales model supplemented by trade distributors for aftermarket channels. Income is mainly from product sales, with no significant licensing or subscription revenue reported.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the earliest and leading domestic producers of engine sealing gaskets in China, holding a significant market share especially in the heavy-duty truck segment and natural gas heavy truck engine sealing. It competes with both domestic and international sealing product manufacturers and is recognized for its synchronous R&D capabilities and product quality. It is a core supplier to major OEMs and is expanding its footprint in new energy vehicle markets and international customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 527 million, a 2.84% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 81.9 million, up 13.18%. Total assets reached RMB 1.22 billion, growing 4.64% from the previous year. The company maintains steady growth with increasing R&D investment and expanding production capacity, supported by a strong cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yantai Ishikawa Sealing Technology differentiates itself through advanced proprietary sealing technologies, high product quality with zero-defect standards, and strong synchronous R&D collaboration with customers. It offers a broad product portfolio tailored to meet stringent emission standards and diverse fuel types, including natural gas and new energy vehicles. The company also emphasizes replacing imported products with domestically developed alternatives, especially in metal coated sheets and fiberboard materials, enhancing cost competitiveness and supply chain stability.
